# Component Patterns — Theme config System

> Reference implementations for the **antd** stack. Every sample uses design tokens only — no hard-coded hex/px.

## Interactive states

Hover effect for this system: **Lift (translateY up + larger shadow)**. Apply the same hover / active / focus pattern to every interactive element.

Ant Design ships hover/active/focus/disabled states built in — tune them through theme tokens instead of CSS: `motionDurationMid` for timing, `controlOutline`/`colorPrimaryHover` for focus & hover. Do not add custom hover classes to antd components.

## Button

Variants: primary, secondary, ghost, destructive · default size: md.

States: default · hover · active · disabled · **loading** (show a spinner, keep width stable, set `aria-busy`).

Padding maps to spacing tokens — sm: `space-1 space-3`, md: `space-2 space-4`, lg: `space-3 space-6`. Radius: `radius-md`/`radius-lg`. Disabled uses neutral tokens + reduced contrast.

Accessibility: always provide a discernible label; visible focus ring; use `type="button"` unless submitting.

```tsx
import { Button } from "antd";
// Theme via <ConfigProvider theme={themeConfig}> — never override colors inline.

<Button type="primary">Primary</Button>
<Button>Default</Button>
<Button type="dashed">Dashed</Button>
<Button type="text">Text</Button>
<Button danger type="primary">Delete</Button>
<Button type="primary" size="md" loading>Loading</Button>
```

## Input

Variant: outline. States: default · focus · error · **success** · disabled · **read-only**.

Border uses the neutral scale; focus ring SHOULD use a brand/info opacity token (`opacity-primary-*`/`opacity-info-5`); error uses `error-500`; helper text uses small/base body styles. Horizontal padding `space-3`–`space-4`, vertical `space-2`–`space-3`.

Accessibility: associate a `<label>`; link errors via `aria-describedby`; set `aria-invalid` on error.

```tsx
import { Form, Input } from "antd";

<Form layout="vertical">
  <Form.Item label="Email" validateStatus={hasError ? "error" : ""} help={hasError ? "Required" : undefined}>
    <Input type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
  </Form.Item>
</Form>
// States via props: status="error", disabled, readOnly. Theme through tokens, not inline styles.
```

## Card

Variants: default · elevated · outlined · **status** (current: elevated). States: default · hover · **selected** · disabled.

Surface uses white/`neutral-50`; border uses neutral scale; shadow `shadow-1`–`shadow-2`; radius `radius-lg`. Padding tiers — compact `space-4`, default `space-6`, spacious `space-8`.

Accessibility: use a landmark/heading structure; ensure interactive cards have a focusable control.

```tsx
import { Card, Button } from "antd";

<Card title="Tiêu đề" variant="borderless"
      extra={<Button type="link">Thêm</Button>}>
  Nội dung thẻ — màu/nền/bo góc lấy từ theme token.
</Card>
```

## Badge

Variants: brand · success · warning · error · info · **neutral**. Semantic family fill + readable foreground; compact spacing only; radius `radius-pill` or `radius-sm`. Include text, never color alone.

```tsx
<span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-[var(--radius-pill)] px-[var(--space-2)] py-[var(--space-1)] text-sm bg-[var(--color-success-100)] text-[var(--color-success-700)]">Active</span>
```

## Modal

Parts: overlay · container · header · body · footer. Overlay MUST use an opacity-black token (`opacity-black-7`); container uses `radius-lg`/`radius-xl`; internal spacing `space-6`–`space-8`; title uses a heading token, body a body token.

Accessibility: `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, focus trap, restore focus on close, Esc to dismiss.

```tsx
<div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="m-title"
     className="bg-white rounded-[var(--radius-lg)] shadow-[var(--shadow-3)] p-[var(--space-6)]">
  <h2 id="m-title" className="text-2xl">Title</h2>
  {/* content */}
</div>
```

## Table

Parts: header · row · cell · **status cell** · **board cell**. Row padding maps to the spacing scale; alignment & spacing MUST stay consistent row-to-row. Status cells use semantic tokens; any categorical "board" colors are reserved for board/visualization cells only.

Accessibility: use `<th scope="col">`, caption, and zebra striping with neutral tokens.

```tsx
<table className="w-full text-left">
  <caption className="sr-only">Users</caption>
  <thead className="bg-[var(--color-neutral-100)]">
    <tr><th scope="col" className="p-[var(--space-3)]">Name</th><th scope="col" className="p-[var(--space-3)]">Role</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr className="border-t border-[var(--color-neutral-200)]"><td className="p-[var(--space-3)]">Ada</td><td className="p-[var(--space-3)]">Admin</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```
